from fastmcp import FastMCP, Context

server = FastMCP("Progress Logger Example", version="1.0.0")


@server.tool(description="Process a list of items and report progress via logging")
async def process_items(items: list[str], ctx: Context) -> str:
    """Process a list of items, logging progress information to the client."""
    results = []
    
    for i, item in enumerate(items, 1):
        # Log progress for each item
        await ctx.info(f"Processing item {i}/{len(items)}: {item}")
        
        # Simulate processing
        processed = item.upper()
        results.append(processed)
    
    await ctx.info(f"Completed processing all {len(items)} items")
    return f"Processed {len(results)} items: {', '.join(results)}"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Run with stdio transport
    server.run()
